title: Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Patron Class Schedule: Class Membership and Annual Allocation
content:
# Patron Class Schedule — Class Membership and Annual Allocation

**Product:** Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), all six patron classes.

The revenue a member is billed on an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account counts toward the patron class that its rate schedule belongs to. Each patron class allocates its own share of the year's distribution margins at the allocation rate shown below.

## Schedule A — rate schedules and allocation rate by class

| Patron class | Rate schedules whose billed revenue is allocated to the class | Allocation rate (percent of the member's patronage revenue in the class for the year) |
|---|---|---|
| Residential Patron Class | Schedule R Residential Service | 4.12 percent |
| Seasonal Patron Class | Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service | 4.12 percent |
| Farm Patron Class | Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | 4.12 percent |
| General Service Patron Class | Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service | 3.64 percent |
| Irrigation Patron Class | Schedule IR Irrigation Service | 3.21 percent |
| Large Power Patron Class | Schedule LP Large Power Service | 1.87 percent |

## Schedule B — terms common to every class

| Term | Value in every patron class |
|---|---|
| Member types that hold accounts in the class | individual, joint, business, nonprofit, government |
| Revenue that counts as patronage | revenue billed excluding taxes and fees: the usage lines billed in the calendar year, less sales tax, fees and program charges |
| Wholesale supplier's capital credits passed through to members on the same patronage | Yes |
| Month in which the prior year's allocations are booked | June (month 6) |
| How members are told of their allocation | the annual statement sent with the June bill |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- The class follows the rate schedule, not the member. A member billed on Schedule FH for the farm home and on Schedule IR for a pivot has patronage in the Farm Patron Class and in the Irrigation Patron Class, each allocated at that class's own rate.
- Schedule GS-1 and Schedule GS-3 revenue both fall in the General Service Patron Class and are allocated at the same 3.64 percent.
- Every listed member type may hold an account in every class; the class is never restricted by member type.
- Sales tax, fees and program charges never count as patronage revenue in any class.
